action: The winter storm rolls in, snow lashing harder and harder, the ground freezing and ice shards rising, then it slowly thins away. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: FIMBULWINTER: a vast killing winter storm over a wide area seen from an elevated three-quarter view, heavy driving snow lines, a dark slate haze along the top edge, frozen ground cracking with frost patterns, ice shards rising, menacing and overwhelming. Palette: frost off-white, glacier blue, slate grey, pine green, muted aurora teal, leather brown, antique bronze. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Norse winter folk style: carved wood and stone, pine and birch, falcon feathers, fur and leather, bronze, physical snow and ice (not glowing crystal). NOT anime, no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no letters, no runes, no text, no Viking horned helmets, no valknut, no religious or political symbols, no wolves, no character, no person, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are frost off-white, never pure white.
